skill: obstacle_reach
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: reach_clearance
  anchor: world
  offset:
  - 0.5
  - 0.0
  - 0.45
  weight: 0.3
- id: reach_goal
  weight: 0.7
phases:
- id: approach_over_obstacle
  type: approach
  generator: arc_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: world
    offset:
    - 0.5
    - 0.0
    - 0.45
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    approach_arc_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.4
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.arc_height
        mode: add
    approach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.2
      default: 0.1
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: add
  retries:
    max_attempts: 0
    strategy: repeat
  subtask_id: reach_clearance
- id: descend_to_goal
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    descend_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: add
  guards:
  - id: force_below_goal
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 5.0
    on_failure: abort
  retries:
    max_attempts: 1
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.01
  subtask_id: reach_goal

subtasks:
- id: reach_clearance
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - 0.18
  weight: 0.3
- id: reach_goal
  weight: 0.7
phases:
- id: approach_over_obstacle
  type: approach
  generator: arc_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.18
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    approach_arc_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.25
      default: 0.18
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.arc_height
        mode: add
    approach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.08
      - 0.3
      default: 0.15
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: add
  subtask_id: reach_clearance
- id: descend_to_goal
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    descend_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.25
      default: 0.12
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: add
  subtask_id: reach_goal
